competences.description: Attacks the enemy with claws and disturbs the enemy's HP recovery for 1 turn.
Recovers the HP of all allies by 20% and their Attack Bar by 15%. Also increases their Attack Speed for 2 turns.

Violently attacks the enemy 4 times to inflict damage proportionate to your MAX HP and removes a beneficial effect with each attack. If you successfully remove a beneficial effect, the damage inflicted by the remaining attacks will be increased by 20%, and the cooldown time will reset if the enemy dies.
